cases.assertion: only the persisted end LSN of a real published heartbeat transaction reaches feedback; keepalive and unrelated WAL remain informational
a non-heartbeat event cannot enter the heartbeat feedback path
source write outage emits degraded status, bounded exponential retry and WAL headroom without feedback advancement
generic materializer writes no user archive row for a control-only transaction and advances only its complete journal boundary
fixed UPDATE and immutable-key SELECT must each observe exactly one administration-seeded row
cadence, retry cap, attempt and healthy/degraded transitions are deterministic and bounded
feedback callback is impossible before journal commit returns and receives only the persisted safe boundary
journal failure or a non-isolated control transaction invokes no sender callback
control routing is destination-independent and has no user-table effect
a failed user transaction cannot advance a destination checkpoint even when it contains a control event
gapped ranges and incomplete transaction ordinals fail closed before checkpoint
